items: One item per line. Empty lines are skipped. Keep each item to a few words.
items_source: Links the list to a multi-line field of the page: each line becomes an item and Items is not used. A page whose field is blank shows no list.
layout: Inline: side by side, wrapping onto the next line. List: one under the other. Grid: in columns, as many as fit.
appearance: Match the section background, so the text and check marks stay easy to read.
text_tone: Body is gray, Heading is black.
